Colorbee Help

Keyboard shortcuts

Every shortcut in Colorbee, as it comes. You can change any of them in Colorbee ▸ Settings ▸ Shortcuts, except the Mac's own, such as Quit and Hide.

Tools and canvas keys

Single keys work whenever you're not typing text.

KeyTool or action
PPencil
BBrush
EEraser
GFill
TText
IEyedropper
ZMagnifier
MRectangle Select
LFree-Form Select
WMagic Wand
UShapes
RMeasure
JRetouch
SClone Stamp
KRedact Brush
NStep Badge
XSwap Colors
DDefault Colors
[Smaller Size
]Larger Size
Space (hold)Move around the image
Shift (while dragging)Keep lines and strokes straight, and shapes in proportion
